turns.doctor_question: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um, well, I came in because I've been having these really difficult thoughts lately. I'm an artist, and recently I was working on a memorial piece for my aunt.

It was like... if I made one wrong photo placement or chose the wrong color, it would mean I didn't actually love her enough. I'm used to second-guessing my work, but I couldn't just brush these off like normal creative doubts. They just kept sticking in my head, and it's been really bothering me.
